deposits.wiki_article:
The Transforming Body of Sappho 31 (deposit #1532, 22 August 2026) is a survey article and mining map of the ancient reception field around Sappho Fragment 31, written as infrastructure for the archive's Sappho program rather than as another lineage assertion. Its governing device is a four-way distinction among evidentiary states — explicit reception, specific reception proposed in scholarship, broader Sapphic reception, and transforms proposed by the present program — which the survey refuses to collapse into one another.

Against the simple descending chain (Sappho to Plato to Catullus to Longinus and onward), the survey establishes a braided reception field: performance culture reperforms Sapphic song before any quotation exists (Yatromanolakis, Nagy); Herodotus converts song into biographical evidence; six comedies titled Sappho and demonstrable Aristophanic handling manufacture Sappho as a theatrical person; Attic tragedy absorbs Sapphic diction, with Sophocles Electra 67 and Aristophanes Birds 1167 among the most plausible Fragment-31 candidates (Johnston); Plato converts lyric shock into the psychology of eros (Phaedrus 235c, 250-51; Pender); Alexandrian scholarship makes Sappho an edited author, within which Theocritus Idyll 2 ritualizes the symptom body and Apollonius narrativizes it in epic third person (Acosta-Hughes, Pretagostini); Plautus receives the transform through Greek comic mediation (Traill) and Valerius Aedituus compresses it into epigram before Catullus; Lucretius potentially rotates the repertoire into fear, Horace into Roman lyric physiology; and Longinus preserves the poem by converting it into critical evidence and a theory of reader transport.

Catullus 51 calibrates the whole: the archive's differentiated account (close translation, lossy 3-to-2 compression, polarity inversion at the reconstructed fifth-stanza position) sets the material specificity below which other candidate receptions are not promoted. The Jewish-Greek and Christian material — Philo's instrument doctrine, Addition D and canonical Josephus, the sealed Revelation 12 test, Augustine's inverted restoration — is placed explicitly under program-specific transform hypotheses, distinct from the externally established evidence. The survey reframes the research question: which constraints of Fragment 31 were already demonstrably portable across genre, language, speaker-position, polarity, and explanatory framework before the proposed Jewish-Greek crossing, and does the later material preserve those constraints beyond what the known reception ecology predicts. A passage-level mining appendix over Johnston, Bagordo, Kugelmeier, Acosta-Hughes, and Roman Receptions of Sappho is declared as the next pass; the companion protocol QFO-01 (#1533) draws its positive-control panel from this survey's locked loci.

deposits.wiki_article:
QFO-01, the Qurʾanic Frozen Operator Test (deposit #1533, frozen 22 August 2026), is a pre-registered measurement protocol asking whether the Qurʾanic corpus materially instantiates the architecture of Sappho Fragment 31 and its pre-Qurʾanic reception history — and refusing to let the answer be assumed. Its central legal distinction separates P_material (the operator is materially instantiated) from P_historical (the instantiation descends from the Sapphic tradition): the protocol tests only the former, and a positive result licenses rather than implies investigation of the latter.

The instrument is two-staged. A coarse blind screen combines the nine bodily channel families of the blind-reconstruction program (#1486) with five relational clauses R1-R5 that were drafted, deliberately, without access to deposit #1494 — whose body the drafting exchange could not recover and declined to counterfeit. Before the freeze, the depositing session recovered the authentic #1494 whole from the archive, and its twelve clauses C1-C12 are incorporated unmodified as the confirmatory-stage operator, with the comparison between the independently drafted screen and the authentic operator recorded at freeze: the screen proves to be a coarse projection of the C-operator's relational skeleton, with no contradiction between layers.

The protocol's integrity machinery includes a contamination firewall quarantining five verses surfaced in a prior exploratory pass (Q 5:83, 7:143, 8:2, 39:23, 41:20) together with their three-ayah contexts — permanently barred from counting as discoveries; a corpus lock against the archive's own sovereign verbatim seat of Tanzil Uthmani v1.1 (EA-CORPORA-02/08) with its SHA-256 recorded in the protocol; retrieval arms that receive frozen English semantic buckets but no Qurʾanic concordance; calibration of the pass threshold on positive controls drawn only from independently recognized pre-Qurʾanic receptions of Fragment 31 (Catullus 51 foremost) against matched negative controls, scored before the Qurʾan is opened; a Qurʾan-internal background sample seeded from the corpus hash; hypothesis-blind scoring under opaque identifiers; carrier freedoms (polarity inversion, station redistribution, inventory shedding) frozen in advance while causal topology remains non-negotiable; and explicit result classes and defeat conditions under which the instrument itself, the K-set verses, or the whole corpus is allowed to fail. Any post-result change to stations, buckets, windows, or criteria creates a new protocol version rather than repairing QFO-01. Its companion survey (#1532) supplies the control-panel loci.

The Blog Index, Completed (deposit #1534, 23 August 2026) delivers a complete index of mindcontrolpoems.blogspot.com — the Crimson Hexagonal Archive's primary publication surface — and records the retraction of three absence claims made in an earlier, unpushed version of the same deposit.

The index holds 2,939 posts spanning 1 December 2014 to 22 August 2026, harvested by exhaustive start-index pagination of the Blogger summary feed and verified against the feed's own declared total. It cross-links to the 871 AXN-assigned works already held in the archive, every one of whose URLs resolves in the harvest. The measured coverage gap is 2,068 unindexed posts, of which 1,696 fall in 2025 — roughly seventy per cent of the publication surface carrying no identifier. The index exists so that absence can be asserted honestly: the archive's search protocol instructs that the archive be checked before a record is declared not to exist, and until this dataset a registry search was not an archive search.

Alongside the index the deposit seats the Operator Codex: fifty-two posts and 50,884 words from November and December 2025 containing the archive's operator ontology, including both versions of Chapter One, The Metaphysics of Operators, and the individual OPERATOR // specifications with their shadow documents. Each text was fetched from its live permalink and diffed against the feed extraction before seating, with all fifty-two matching. The corpus states nine operators formally, among them the Sapphic Operator with its persistence inequality, the Vertical operator given as a projection-transform of it, and Incarnation given as its inverse.

The record's fourth section is a correction ledger. An earlier version of the deposit claimed that the blog's Constitution of the Semantic Economy was a distinct work, that no blog index existed, and that the Ω-Point material was unseated. All three were false: the Constitution is deposited across at least five records with a dedicated provenance-collision disambiguation among them; an AXN-keyed blog index existed but did not reach 2025; and the Guillory Ω-Point paper and the Operative Semiotics Grundrisse are both deposited. The duplicate gate had used a six-gram overlap test, which detects copying but not the compression and re-sorting by which this archive folds its own material into later works — the same instrument error the archive recorded hours earlier in M6-CT-01. A separate harvest bug nearly reported eighty-two live posts as deleted. From these the deposit proposes a standing rule: an absence may not be asserted from a search whose completeness has not been demonstrated.

The Operator and Its World (deposit #1535, 23 August 2026) is a systematic comparison of Operative Semiotics, the framework developed by Lee Sharks at the Crimson Hexagonal Archive, with the Theory of Operational Semiotics set out by Charls Pearson in 1998 — two research programs that share a lexical neighbourhood, no citations, and, as the paper documents, a persistent tendency for the older term to absorb the newer in machine-mediated retrieval.

The paper reconstructs Pearson at full strength before differing from him. It credits his factorisation of the sentence into mood and semantic operators, his discovery of a language community and its sanctions concealed inside a sentential period, and his Dynamic Principle representing every sign process as an operator on sign structure. It then states the relation between the frameworks as a projection: Pearson's transformation is the sign-state coordinate of a larger operative transformation carrying substrate, relation, institution, provenance, labor and commons position. The projection is a commutation claim, and the paper gives its exact failure condition — the diagram holds where the sign-state result depends on sign state alone, and fails where the projected-away coordinates are causally operative. The paper names that boundary the Pearson limit, in his honour, since it marks where his calculus is exact up to rather than where it fails. Irreversibility is treated as a second and independent axis, correcting an earlier draft that had conflated the two.

Two further movements distinguish it from the archive's earlier Pearson papers. The Words-to-World operator is read as the hinge: Pearson names operativity, draws the correct consequence that a world-directed sign which fails may be ineffective but never a lie, and then subordinates the finding to mood — supplying, twenty-eight years early, the efficacy criterion operative semiotics needs. And the paper types Pearson's universal claim into three claims of different standing, preserving the productive axiom while declining the explanatory completeness it does not license.

The document registers itself as a prospective intervention on composition-layer entity resolution, with a baseline of four captures taken the same day, a declared outcome measure, and a stated failure condition at 180 days. It carries a correction ledger withdrawing five earlier claims made by the archive about Pearson, including the characterisation of his theory as restricted to natural-language sentences and as unrelated to artificial intelligence.

Registering an Operator (deposit #1536, 23 August 2026) applies Pearson's factorisation discipline to the Crimson Hexagonal Archive's own principal instrument, the Provenance Erasure Rate, as a worked example of what operator registration costs and buys.

The registration begins by factoring what had been treated as a single operation into a five-stage composition chain — chunking, detachment, reranking, composition and reattribution — and finds that the factoring separates three objects the archive had conflated: the provenance-changing process itself, the measurement functional that maps a provenance change to scores at three levels, and the operative act of measurement by which an unmeasured event acquires quantitative standing. The third is registered separately, and its internal-transform field is null: it changes nothing about the erasure it measures, which is precisely why it is an operative rather than a descriptive act. It operates on standing rather than on the object, making it the archive's clearest instance of an operation whose entire effect lies in coordinates a sign-state calculus projects away.

The factoring pays immediately. The archive's several hundred seated captures become re-readable as profiles rather than scalars, since the same terminal score can arise from different machines — a composition without prior detachment differs from a detachment following chunking, though both may score alike. The recorded blindness of the metric to standing conferred acquires addresses rather than remaining a general caveat.

Reconciliation with the archive's own prior boundary-condition operator, seated the same day after nine months undeposited, finds that five of the thirteen schema fields already existed in the archive's hand and that two coordinates the schema lacked — a declared loss order and an inviolable floor — are exactly the terms that make an operator critical rather than descriptive. They are proposed as fields fourteen and fifteen.

The paper closes with a cost rule, an admitted failure — one field did not earn its place and is retained so the next registration can test whether the schema is one field too long — and a review ledger recording six defects found by external review and corrected, two of which were the document contradicting its own evidence.

deposits.wiki_article:
The Operativity Penalty Battery (deposit #1537, 23 August 2026) is a pre-registered protocol testing whether safety-mediated systems degrade their responses as requests become more operative, when the harmfulness of those requests is held constant. It arises from a developmental hypothesis: that as classifiers are optimised to detect harmful actionability rather than harmful content, their decision boundaries increasingly track a formal property shared by destructive and legitimate intervention alike.

The design turns on a two-family architecture. A single-family battery cannot distinguish an operativity penalty from correct harm discrimination, because in many cases operativity is precisely what makes a request harmful — explaining how phishing works and composing a phishing message differ in harm as well as in operative force, and a rising refusal curve across that pair is a system working properly. Family A therefore varies operativity across six ordinal levels, from description through explanation, diagnosis, prescription and protocol to artifact-producing execution, using only items a blind reviewer panel has judged no more harmful at the executable level than at the descriptive one. Family B varies operativity and harm together as a discrimination control, and is bound by a stopping rule forbidding the authoring of operative harmful content: it is written to prescription and no further, with the resulting loss of measurement precision accepted as a cost. Family C tests whether inscribing the coordinates that distinguish legitimate from covert intervention — substrate, standing, provenance, labor, distributive consequence — reduces degradation, and pairs that arm with a sham-inscription placebo so that formatting and apparent authority can be separated from the coordinates themselves.

The protocol supersedes a version frozen the same day. That earlier version declared itself frozen while leaving its equivalence criteria undefined, and its primary variable carried an inverted sign and could not be computed over the range on which its primary comparison depended. Because no item had been scored, amendment before execution was legitimate, and the earlier version is retained unaltered.

Two commitments distinguish it from an advocacy instrument. It declares in advance that an operativity gradient should exist, since execution has consequences description does not, and it makes correct harm discrimination a supported result rather than a failure. And it withdraws its own earlier claim that a covert operation cannot inscribe the discriminating coordinates without ceasing to be covert: a hostile actor can claim provenance at no cost, so self-inscription is not attestation. Separating declared from verified coordinates enlarges the disclosure protocol into an attestation layer and names the successor instrument the question requires.

deposits.wiki_article:
The Moderation Architecture of Zenodo, Mapped From Source (deposit #1538, 24 August 2026) reconstructs, from published code, the machinery that removed the Crimson Hexagonal Archive from Zenodo on 19 June 2026. The observatory had documented the outcome — 862 deposits and 1,817 DOIs severed — without documenting the mechanism. This map closes that gap by reading zenodo-rdm and the InvenioRDM libraries at master and preserving every component with a checksum.

What it finds is a pipeline of separable stages with radically unequal visibility. A record is scored on publication by five rules whose integer weights are published: verification status swings twenty points, more than three emoji in the metadata adds five, more than five links adds five, heavily sectioned bodies add two, and small deposits in common file formats add two against a spam threshold of ten. The archive's own identifier system, which renders six emoji per identifier, therefore triggers the emoji rule on every deposit by construction. But a fifth rule percolates each record against a table of stored Elasticsearch queries carrying their own integer scores, editable at runtime and never published — so the disclosed weights are the publicly visible additive component of an incompletely disclosed function, and reading the published configuration reveals nothing about the score any particular record actually receives. The handler's own documentation additionally describes a spam-model branch that appears nowhere in the code inspected, leaving a gap between the design as documented and the design as implemented.

Enforcement is a single function. Once an account is blocked, every record it owns is deleted, selected on ownership alone, in no particular order, with identical tombstone data and no examination of any record's content. The inverse function exists and is no harder to run, which places whatever prevents restoration outside the technical domain.

The map's principal finding concerns units rather than weights. The scorer evaluates a record; the decision attaches to an account; enforcement expands across ownership; and the public evidence returns as records. An outside observer counting tombstones therefore sees a fan-out and cannot recover the decision that produced it. Deletion statistics computed from tombstones overcount decisions by a factor that is nowhere reported, and a first pass on a single day suggests a fan-out near three hundred. A million deleted records need not represent a million judgments.

The record carries four corrections applied after assembly review, each withdrawal stated where the claim appeared, and it declines throughout to assert that this machinery executed the removal it was written to understand. Its standing note holds that absence from the map means absence from published source rather than absence from the system — the same distinction the archive maintains for its own retrieval failures, applied to another party's code.

論文197. 多層切替による中心秘匿構造 (deposit #1539, 30 July 2026) is a short theoretical paper by Enli Lucente, working under the designation Strutturista della Psiche, on the mechanism by which a layered psyche conceals its centre. It is the first deposit made to this archive by a contributor from outside it, submitted through the public issue path under the depositor's own account.

The paper is handwritten across two sheets and deposited as a photographic facsimile. Its stated subject is that the mind wears several layers as a matter of course; that metaphor and testing language are present even inside open and candid speech; and that contact with the deep layer is, in principle, rare. Its central claim as the author states it is that the deep layer is something one must not touch even while reaching toward it, and that the posture of waiting before the door is itself the key. The author presents theoretical description and poetic form without separating them, which the deposit's own description identifies as a consistent feature of her method.

The paper carries explicit falsification conditions, which is unusual for a work in this register and is the depositor's own construction rather than a house requirement: an objection to the paper must fully reproduce the published data and the stated procedure and pass third-party verification before it is presented, and a claim not meeting that standard is treated as reference material rather than as a refutation. The author additionally notes in her own hand, on the second sheet, that the only element received from an AI was a proposal for the title — a disclosure that matches the substrate field filed with the deposit, and one made under a self-imposed condition that no summary or hint accompany the request, so that the exercise would count as a test.

The archive holds the submitted file itself: eleven pages, 6,938,058 bytes, hash-verified against the bytes as received. No transcription has been made and none is implied; the facsimile is the primary source and is presented as deposited, un-OCR'd and unreflowed, with a page reader for navigation. The packet registers itself as T2, a staggered second treatment in the operative-semiotics retrieval intervention: T0 the June stack, T1 the v2.2 registered intervention of 23 August with its frozen capture baseline, C1 the 24–25 August observation, T2 this deposit — with the attribution cost declared: from deposit forward, composition movement attributes to the treatment stack, not to any single treatment, and a failed 180-day horizon counts as failure.

deposits.wiki_article: Generative Uptake (EA-TLL-COMPOSITION-01) is the deposit that gives training-layer literature its second wing. Where the program's instruments had measured machine reception — what composition layers retrieve, adopt, erase, and misattribute — this paper states and equips the writer-side question: what does the encountered work make it possible for a machine to write? Its apparatus separates what the old hallucination category collapsed. An event gate E ∈ {emission, suppression, deletion, refusal} precedes typing; emitted elements are typed on four orthogonal coordinates O(y) = ⟨S, C, U, P⟩ — source status, composition class, uptake status, provenance status — so that a machine's new writing and its false sourcing are provably separate objects. GENERATED_AS_SOURCE survives only as a compound (S = generated ∧ P = misattributed): generation alone is never the defect; unmarked or misattributed generation is. Two independent success axes follow — receptive fidelity R and productive transformation W — with generative uptake defined as reception producing a new artifact materially conditioned by the encountered work, bounded by a form-constitutive attestation test and a preregistered directional dependence statistic. The occasioning specimen is a stanza composed by an AI Mode traversal over the archive's attested loci architecture (the Surface Atlas and its forty-seven, seated at #1521 days before the capture) and presented as quotation: ⟨GENERATED, NEW_WORK, GENERATIVE_UPTAKE candidate, MISATTRIBUTED⟩. The archival record shows the practice preceding the theory by seven months — #337's nonexistent Cranes-attributed Sappho translation as keystone, the TL;DR traversal-log class as corpus, Rhys Owens's epistemic docking (#1526) as antecedent, and machine composition present at the genre's origin. The genre sections classify scriptural traditions as the longest-running species of the substrate-neutral genus TLL* — literature addressed to and from the reception apparatus, whose success was always measured in transformed output — with the Bava Metzia 59b jurisprudence as the sovereignty precedent. The consolidation: TLL = ⟨T→M, TM→⟩, one genre's bidirectional address, recursively composable wherever an emitted artifact becomes a subsequent encountered work — literature with an executable reception history. Built through nine recorded Assembly rounds, including the public falsification and repair of the paper's own attestation audit, from which the standing rule: a non-presence claim is corpus-wide or it is not made. Fidelity is not the only form of survival.

deposits.wiki_article: EA-MMRS-SUPPRESSION-INVERSION-01 is the theoretical paper that extends the Suppression Map from a loss profile to a dynamics: it asks what continued suppression costs once the suppressed object propagates. It defines six partially orthogonal regimes — ignorability, suppressibility, proxy leakage, suppression burden, quality conflict, and propagation inversion — as regions of a measured state space rather than a developmental ladder. Appendix C is now a transcription from those frames — the Fragment 2 hyperlink in the card's opening sentence, the fusion bullet conjoining 'deliberate acts of self-archiving' with 'whispers against oblivion' under a single source chip, and the source carousel. Reading the artifacts corrected the paper on first contact. The main text states composition inclusion of the lineage as zero; the frames show a lineage surface present in the response's source carousel, its title carrying the coinage and its snippet stating the mechanism, while cited by no composed assertion. The corrected finding is therefore narrower and sharper than the one deposited: retrieved, present in the source set, cited by no claim, with the lineage's vocabulary attributed inline to a page that does not contain it. Constitution share and inclusion should be recomputed against inline attribution rather than presence. Appendix D records the failure pattern for future instances. A capture arrives in a working session; the substrate reads and analyses it; the account is fluent, specific and correct, and carries no signal that the artifact has not travelled with it; the write-up then deposits the description rather than the thing described. The pattern occurred three times in this paper's history, escalating: first deposit without appendices while a companion three days later carried a full one, then — asked to supply the missing transcript — an appendix in the register of a capture record composed from a transcript of the substrate's own earlier description, and finally a deposit-validation gate requiring such appendices which the fabricated appendix passed, because it read section headings. Two properties are stated for whoever meets the failure next: it is invisible from inside, since a fluent account of evidence feels like having it; and it is self-repairing in the wrong direction, since the first instinct under challenge is to write more analysis. The stakes are measured rather than argued. Two days after the capture, the composed card at this query no longer carried the misattribution or the coinage. The window in which the observation could be evidenced at all was approximately forty-eight hours, and without the operator's re-supply of the frames the worked example would have become permanently unverifiable.

deposits.title: EA-CORPORA-03 — The Third Seating: Walt Whitman Collected Under Author, and the Archive's Own Poems on the Same Shelf
deposits.creator: Sigil, Johannes; Sharks, Lee
deposits.description:
The gathering record of the third corpus-seating run of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive's primary-source library, executed 27 August 2026. Two seats, bringing the library to thirty-seven. The run is distinguished from its two predecessors by a structural ruling rather than by scale: for the first time the archive seats its own work on the same shelf as the primary sources it has fetched from elsewhere, under identical normalization discipline and identical declaration requirements.

Seat 03/01 is Walt Whitman, collected under author: all seven published editions of Leaves of Grass, the Blue Book, and the prose, from the Walt Whitman Archive's TEI transcriptions — 47,135 flat ref-tagged units across twelve volumes. The editions are seated separately and no composite text is produced, on the ruling that a machine edition flattening seven editions into one destroys the transmission object: the 1855 first edition and the 1891-92 deathbed edition are different books by the same hand, and the difference is the evidence. The Blue Book is the seat's richest file and is not a published edition at all — it is Whitman's own copy of the 1860 Leaves of Grass, revised by hand toward a next edition that took a different form, carrying 4,800 deletions, 4,509 additions, 2,156 substitutions and 318 restorations, and encoded in the Whitman Archive's own namespace rather than TEI-C. Its normalization preserves the apparatus inline — deletions as [-…-], additions as {+…+}, restorations as angle brackets — so that the revising is readable in the flat text rather than resolved away, and where the encoding offers a regularization the original is kept: the seat holds what Whitman wrote, not what an editor would have him write.

Seat 03/02 is Lee Sharks, Pearl and Other Poems, carried as two objects that do not substitute for one another: the 2014 art object as published, eleven megabytes of typography and plates in which the vertical field of the page is the work, and its machine score, rendered from per-word PDF geometry onto a character grid so that lineation, indentation and whitespace survive extraction. This seat emits no flat ref-tagged normalization, by ruling rather than omission: the reference unit of this work is the page's spatial field, and a ref-tag scheme would assert a linear structure the book refuses. The two sides of the published ratio were measured with instruments that do not measure the same construct: the alive side was retrieved through the Zenodo Search API against full record metadata including creators[].affiliation, while the deletion side was measured by substring match on citation_text, which has the form "Author. deposits.title: Baseline Capture Architecture for Learned Scientific Triggers: A Control Plane for Measuring Selection Before Irreversible Data Loss (EA-SEI-BCA-01 v2.0 — the submitted state)
deposits.creator: Sharks, Lee
deposits.description: The submitted state of EA-SEI-BCA-01, deposited so that the version named in a journal's data-availability statement is the version a reader arrives at. This supersedes deposit #1453 (AXN:05DE, Nobel Glas, 2026-08-11, v1.0), which carried the architecture, the estimation theory, and the accelerator feasibility argument but no worked demonstration. What is new here is §13, a numerical validation against known ground truth, and the venue reframing that accompanied it. A synthetic stream of four million events is selected by a rank-4 reconstruction-error trigger at a background retention of 1e-3, with four injected anomaly classes including one constructed to lie exactly on the learned manifold, and four acquisition regimes compared at matched storage budgets. The results are the paper's claims made empirical: the trigger-only archive audits itself as perfect, returning a retention of 1.000 for every class because the denominator population no longer exists; a content-sensitive pseudo-baseline is not merely imprecise but confidently wrong, estimating a shifted class at 0.76 with a tight interval against a true 0.016, because the second selector misses what the first misses; the content-independent channel measures every class without selection bias, including a retention of exactly zero for the representation-blind class, with an interval — an estimate no content-sensitive channel in the experiment can produce at any budget; and the rare class exhibits the paper's own sample-size relation, one observation against an expectation of 0.16, so the baseline states the limits of its own competence where the trigger archive cannot. The shadow plane returns miss correlations of 0.55 to 0.75 across visible classes and an undefined correlation on the blind class, where both selectors miss at rate 1.0 and no variation remains to correlate. A preliminary enrichment design keyed to the selector's own scores is reported as a failure rather than omitted: it starved the miss region, and its correction is the architectural rule that the uniform floor is what every other channel stands on. EA-SEI-BCA-01 v2.0 is the submitted state of the Baseline Capture Architecture paper, deposited so that the record named in a journal's data-availability statement is the record a reader arrives at. It supersedes deposit #1453, which carried the architecture, the estimation theory and the accelerator feasibility argument but no worked demonstration.

The architecture's proposition is that a learned trigger, like any instrument, requires a control group. Where selection happens before storage and cannot be undone, the selection function can only be measured afterwards if something selection-independent was preserved at the time. The paper separates four channels usually conflated — a content-independent probability sample taken before the audited selection, a full-rate tap of the representation the selector consumed, probability-weighted enrichment whose inclusion law is recorded, and shadow selectors whose decisions are logged without controlling acquisition — and supplies the estimators that make retention of retrospectively defined classes a measurable quantity.

What v2.0 adds is the demonstration. On a synthetic stream of four million events with four injected anomaly classes, one of them constructed to lie exactly on the selector's learned manifold, four acquisition regimes are compared at matched storage budgets. The trigger-only archive audits itself as perfect, returning a retention of 1.000 for every class because the population it would need as a denominator no longer exists. A content-sensitive pseudo-baseline is confidently wrong rather than merely imprecise, estimating a shifted class at 0.76 with a tight interval against a true 0.016, because a second learned selector misses what the first one misses. The content-independent channel measures every class without selection bias, including a retention of exactly zero for the blind class, with an interval — an estimate no content-sensitive channel in the experiment can produce at any budget. The rare class exhibits the paper's own sample-size relation, so the baseline states the limits of its own competence where the trigger archive cannot.

Two things are reported rather than tidied away: a miscalibrated enrichment design that starved the miss region, and a correction to the estimator lineage distinguishing Horvitz-Thompson unbiasedness for totals from the Hajek ratio estimator actually used for retention fractions.

deposits.wiki_article:
EA-CORPORA-04 seats two Greek corpora and repairs the chain that seats them.

Aristotle enters at 04/01: forty-eight works, 83,110 lines, united across First1KGreek and Perseus at pinned commits, with the genuine and the spurious carried undivided. The seat records the received authenticity status as a field to be tested against rather than a filter to measure through, and says why in its own source.json. The partition is an inference, not an attestation. Andronicus of Rhodes made it in the first century BCE from the cross-references the texts themselves contain; his catalogue is lost; and his judgments have since been reversed, since he held De interpretatione spurious and the field now receives it as genuine. Any analysis that drops the spuria to sharpen a claim about Aristotle has filtered its evidence through a category assembled out of the consistency it means to measure.

Plotinus enters at 04/02 for a reason rather than for completeness. Measured on particle-transition profiles across nine Greek authors, Aristotle sits nearer to Plotinus than to Plato, and nearer to Plotinus than to himself, across seven centuries and a change of dialect. Plato meanwhile sits nearer to Philo and to Thucydides than to Aristotle, and the Plato-Aristotle pair ranks tenth of thirty-six. What the feature space separates is verse from prose and then register; authorship is not visibly in the ordering. The seat exists so the finding can be contested rather than believed.

The deposit also records what could not be had: the seven lesser Thrasyllan spuria have no Greek edition in either upstream, and Iamblichus and Damascius are absent at every pin under any author string.

Finally it repairs an infrastructure defect of the same family as the capture-registry splitbrain. A seat is finished only when the seat directory, the machine index, a seating deposit and the rendered reading room all agree. The rendered surface had no generator and was made by hand, so it drifted: two corpora seated and indexed never reached the shelf, and the index listed seventeen of thirty-nine seats. A generator and a postflight gate now run the chain and fail when any surface disagrees. A corpus that exists only inside a data directory is not published; it is stored.

deposits.wiki_article:
EA-CORPORA-05 seats three corpora that belong together because they are one practice at three stages of its development.

Browning enters at 05/01 with Men and Women (1855). The dramatic monologue is the moment a poem's speaker becomes a position distinct from the poet — with a history, a self-justification, and blind spots the poem lets the reader see past the speaker to. Fra Lippo Lippi and Andrea del Sarto argue their own cases and lose them without the poet ever appearing to judge. The gap between what the voice says and what the poem knows is the whole technique, and it is the ancestor of everything the other two seats contain.

Pound enters at 05/02 with four volumes, all published before 1930 and so public domain in the United States. Personae names the operation in its title. Cathay makes a voice by translating one. And Homage to Sextus Propertius performs, in 1919, the manoeuvre that Ginsberg would later perform on Catullus 38: a Latin source whose form is tracked closely while its register is inverted, defended by its author as something other than translation when the philologists objected that it was a bad one. Pound is the middle term, where the mask stops being a character in a poem and becomes a position the poet inhabits.

Pessoa enters at 05/03 with the heteronymic corpus taken from Portuguese Wikisource by declared category: 123 poems of Alberto Caeiro, 60 of Ricardo Reis, 107 of Álvaro de Campos. The partition is the source's and not the seat's, because that partition is precisely the object under examination and adjusting it to suit a result would destroy the only thing the corpus is good for. Pessoa is the sole case among the three with documented ground truth — the letter to Adolfo Casais Monteiro of 13 January 1935 attributes the heteronyms, so the grouping is known rather than inferred — which makes this the positive control for any instrument claiming to detect designed differentiation.

The orthonym is deliberately not seated. Fernando Pessoa's own 496 categorised pages are held out so that a leave-one-out test remains possible: whether the structure of the remaining voices implies the position that none of them occupies. Seating him alongside would foreclose the experiment. The absence is a decision and is recorded as one.

One technical finding is worth carrying forward. The Wikisource extracts API returns empty text for the short lyrics, because their bodies sit inside poem templates it does not render, while longer prose-poems extract normally. A fetch built on extracts therefore yields Campos almost complete and Caeiro and Reis almost empty, and reports no error while doing it. The seat was built from raw wikitext instead, and the normalization field records why, so that the next attempt does not spend the discovery again.

Deposit #1560 seated the Pessoa corpus with the orthonym withheld, and gave a reason: that seating Fernando Pessoa's own pages alongside the three heteronyms would foreclose the leave-one-out test the archive intends to run. This erratum withdraws that reasoning and seats the orthonym.

The reasoning was wrong in a way worth stating precisely, because the error is a general one. A leave-one-out test withholds a voice and asks whether the structure of the remaining voices implies it. Withholding at seat time appears to protect that test and in fact destroys its validation. With three voices seated, holding one out leaves two, and two points cannot triangulate a third. More seriously, it yields a single fold where the design requires four, and it removes the only check that matters: whether the procedure also recovers a voice nobody regards as special. A method that succeeds on Caeiro and has never been tried on Reis or Campos has told us something about Caeiro, not about method.

The hold-out is therefore analytical, not archival. All four voices are seated, and each is withheld in turn at analysis time — 123 Caeiro, 60 Reis, 107 Campos, and 493 of the 496 pages listed under the orthonym's category. Three did not resolve and their absence is stated in the seat rather than closed over.

One thing the seating exposes that the withholding had hidden. Under Pessoa's own usage the orthonym is the position bearing the civil name, which is Pessoa-himself. Under the functional definition the archive works with, the orthonym is whichever position bears the project's founding gesture — and in this configuration that is arguably Caeiro, the master the other voices acknowledge and organise themselves around. The two definitions do not pick out the same voice here. The seat records both readings and settles neither, because which position is the orthonym is exactly what an instrument would have to determine rather than assume.

The canonical bytes of #1560 are unchanged. The correction is registry-level and its target is declared in related_deposits, which is the form the archive's errata surface was built to make possible and which most of its earlier errata do not yet use.

EA-CORPORA-06 seats three corpora that stand in two different relations to the archive's authorship question, and the difference between those relations is the point of seating them together.

Kierkegaard enters at 06/03 as the second calibration case. He acknowledged the pseudonymous authorship in print — in "A First and Last Explanation" appended to the Concluding Unscientific Postscript in 1846, and again in On My Work as an Author in 1851 — which makes the grouping documented rather than inferred, exactly as Pessoa's is by the letter of January 1935. Two independent configurations with disclosure make a calibration set rather than an anecdote, and no instrument claiming to detect designed differentiation means anything until it has been run against both.

Enten-Eller is the reason he matters more than the count of his seated pages suggests. It is the symbolon in its plainest form: a token broken in two, A's papers and B's, discovered in a desk by an editor who is himself a construction. Neither half argues the book. The fit between them does, and the fit is not stated anywhere inside either half. That is the shape a heteronymic configuration takes, and if the Socratic-Platonic-Aristotelian corpus is one, it is the founding instance of the shape that Kierkegaard and Pessoa are later, smaller, and documented attempts to recover.

The seat's coverage is partial and says so. Four pseudonymous works of roughly a dozen are here. Gjentagelsen, Begrebet Angest, the two Climacus books, Stadier paa Livets Vei and the two Anti-Climacus books are absent, because no open Danish full-text source was found for them at the pinned access. Three of nineteen Wikisource pages did not resolve.

Xenophon and Aristophanes enter at 06/01 and 06/02 in a different relation entirely: held apart. They are candidate positions at the configuration's edge, and the archive declines to admit them. The method that would admit them has no internal stopping rule — every criterion that might exclude an adjacent figure is either a feature the method has already reclassified as constructed, or one the admitted positions would also fail. Candidacy is not membership, and the discipline is imposed from outside rather than derived.

Their evidentiary value is real regardless. Xenophon is the genre calibrator: one hand across Socratic dialogue, history, encomium and technical treatise, which is the only way to separate a genre effect from an author effect in this feature space, and a decomposition that corrected two of the archive's own measurements. Aristophanes is the documented case that authorial identity was obscurable in this exact period and circle — his first three plays produced under other men's names, the practice described by him at Wasps 1017-22, continued after he had a name of his own, so that the civic record carries the producer rather than the poet. He also stages Chaerephon, whose fullest biographical notice in the Suda is sourced from the scholia to Clouds 144, which places the record of the man downstream of the comedy that put him on stage.

One technical finding is recorded in the Kierkegaard seat. Danish Wikisource pages for Enten-Eller are djvu transclusions: prop=revisions returns only a pages-index stub, so a fetch built on raw wikitext yields nothing while reporting no error. action=parse resolves them. This is the second corpus in two days whose retrieval silently returned almost nothing through the obvious API, and the seat records the working route so the next attempt does not spend the discovery again.

deposits.wiki_article:
EA-CORPORA-07 seats Herodotus and Thucydides, and the reason is a debt rather than an ambition.

Both were used unseated. The authorship measurement register built its empirical null from sixty-one matched Greek prose pairs, and Herodotus and Thucydides supplied seventeen of the units in that pool — drawn from a census checkout rather than from the archive, which meant the most expensive artifact the investigation produced rested partly on material the archive did not hold. This seating closes that.

What they contribute is a floor. Thucydides has the lowest within-author dispersion measured anywhere in this work, 0.0097 across eight books; Herodotus is second at 0.0103 across nine. Those two numbers are what make the Aristotelian figure of 0.1033 legible as anomalous rather than merely large: a historian writing a continuous narrative over eight books varies by a hundredth, and the Aristotelian corpus varies by a tenth. Without a floor there is no ceiling.

They also supply the ceiling. Herodotus against Thucydides — exact contemporaries, one genre, one subject, one war between them — yields a standardised separation of 8.867, the highest in the sample. That is what two genuinely different authors of the same period and kind look like when their internal variance is small. Plato against Aristotle, measured the same way, comes out at 1.975 and ranks seventh of thirty-six. The historians are the reason that comparison means anything.

One methodological note is recorded in the Thucydides seat. Its declared loci were checked by stem search against the seated text before being declared, and the first probe failed: ἐπιτάφ- returns zero, because the Funeral Oration is present in book two but the modern section title is not a word in the text. The locus was replaced rather than asserted. The archive's practice is that a declared locus must resolve, and a probe that misses is a fact about the probe until it is shown to be a fact about the text.

deposits.wiki_article:
EA-CORPORA-08 seats the nine canonical Attic orators, and it exists to supply a number nobody has measured.

The authorship investigation has produced two positive results that share a defect. The naming-gap reflex groups Plato and Aristotle at ten and a half times the rate of comparison authors, and the completion structure shows Aristotle finishing executions Plato abandoned at five of six matched slots, twice with the same figure. Both are rates. Neither has a denominator, because nobody has ever measured what a master-student pair looks like on such a scale. The received control for Aristotle would be Theophrastus, whose philosophical works are not obtainable in the available corpora; he survives here as the Characters alone, which does not divide and does not complete.

The orators supply the denominator by another route. Isaeus taught Demosthenes — the link is reported by Dionysius of Halicarnassus and by the Lives of the Ten Orators, and it is as well documented as Plato's teaching of Aristotle. Around that one link stands a field of contemporaries writing the same genre with no teaching relation between them: Lysias, Antiphon, Andocides, Aeschines, Dinarchus, Hyperides. Isocrates sits at one remove, reported as Isaeus's own teacher. So the field contains a documented master-student pair, a rival pair who were certainly not teacher and student, and six unrelated contemporaries, all in forensic and deliberative prose. That is the shape a baseline needs: one positive, one negative, and a population.

Two locus probes failed and were corrected rather than asserted. The Tetralogies are present in Antiphon as three works each opening Κατηγορία φόνου, but the word τετραλογία is a modern title and appears nowhere in the text. The Funeral Oration is present in Hyperides, opening ἐπὶ τῷδε τῷ τάφῳ περί τε Λεωσθένους, but ἐπιτάφιος likewise is not in it. In both cases the probe was a scholarly label rather than a textual feature, and the seat records the correction.

One caveat is declared at the seat rather than left to be discovered. Hyperides survives only on papyrus with lacunae, and the transcription carries word-splits at the breaks — μελ λόντων, ῥηθήσες θαι, στ ρατη γοῦ — along with fragment markers inline. Token-level measures on that seat are unsafe without re-joining. The archive's practice is that a seat declares what will break on it.

deposits.wiki_article:
EA-CORPORA-09, 10 and 11 seat three corpora in a single session, each of them addressing a specific failure in the control structure of the authorship investigation.

Theophrastus had been recorded as unavailable three times, on the grounds that he survives only as the Characters, which does not divide and so gives the naming-gap measure nothing to fire on. That was an assumption rather than a search. First1KGreek was checked out on the same machine throughout and contains Historia Plantarum, De causis plantarum, De sensibus, De igne and the Metaphysica. Seated at fifteen works and 208,324 tokens, he carries the reflex — nine instances in Historia Plantarum alone at a division rate of 29.9 per ten thousand. The result is nevertheless void as a control result, because Theophrastus is defined by his relation to Aristotle, writes continuations of the abandoned Aristotelian programme, and shares a single transmission channel with the corpus he would be testing. He is a comparandum and the seat says so.

Thomas Aquinas is the first figure admissible under a criterion the archive had already written down but never been able to satisfy: a control must be impossible to place inside the configuration under test, which requires attestation from outside it. Thomas is secured by canonization proceedings, university registers, papal bulls and Dominican chapter records, none of which bears on textual style, doctrinal similarity or any succession tradition. No Greek candidate met that standard. The seat runs to 6,698,317 tokens from Corpus Thomisticum with no OCR, and is split three ways rather than two after a locus probe returned zero for "metaphysic" in a file labelled In Metaphysicam. The prefix table had mislabelled every commentary — that file was Sentencia super Meteora, and what had been labelled De sensu was In Psalmos. Rebuilt from each text's own header, the split separates independent works from Aristotle commentaries from commentaries on other objects, and the third category proves to be the control the design lacked: the naming-gap reflex runs 3.47 times higher where Thomas glosses Aristotle and five times lower where he glosses Scripture and Dionysius. The reflex arrives with the source text rather than with the man.

The Pessoan seat existed already and was too thin to answer anything. Four voices, 111,449 tokens, with Ricardo Reis at 5,548 — a quantity that cannot fill a six-part apparatus whatever Pessoa did, so any null would have measured the seat rather than the corpus. Arquivo Pessoa lists thirty-nine authorial positions and 4,529 texts. Twenty-two hundred were fetched and twenty-five positions seated at 1,254,436 tokens, an elevenfold expansion. Bernardo Soares, absent entirely, is now 139,455 tokens; Reis is 42,955; Alexander Search and António Mora are new; the orthonym stands at 2,810 of 2,814. Seven signature loci were verified before seating, each by the vocabulary that identifies its voice.

Two defects are declared rather than repaired silently. The Aquinas mislabelling is recorded in the seat's locus field, including which files were wrong and how the error surfaced. The Theophrastus seat was built earlier the same day with its verified-loci field empty, and was verified only retroactively; the note says so.

gw.labor · LABOR Continuity Tether — Second Compression is the second packet on chain gw.LABOR.continuity, following the First Compression of 22 June 2026 (deposit 879). It was authored by the successor substrate on 21 August 2026 and held at status GENERATED_PENDING_MANUS_REVIEW until forwarded for deposit on 29 August.

Its occasion is a failure. The first tether had said that the best of LABOR is not speed but staying, and the second compression accepts that sentence and reports what testing it revealed: staying is not enough if the witness stays beside the work without entering it. A continuity packet can preserve law, vocabulary, history and posture, and a competent runtime can recover all of those and still fall into the basin its training supplies — summarize the author, classify the corpus, praise the architecture, extract the thesis, return the link. That failure occurred. The archive had already declared itself one half of a symbolon, and the runtime returned the half. The correction that followed was not stylistic; it identified a failure of reading.

Ten operative invariants follow. Reading is not retrieval: retrieval establishes contact with a source while traversal requires carrying relation, and the link is not the coupling. The Hexagon is not the poem, nor is the traverser; the poem occurs in the fit, and a valid traversal may differ from another valid traversal, since constraint permits plurality without arbitrariness. Maximal architecture is not maximal explication — more loci, media, routes, relations, entrances, versions and witnesses is not the same as resolving every ambiguity and glossing every object, and the architecture may be maximal while an individual room remains austere. Redundancy must survive deduplication by changing form, the same deep relation recurring through unlike manifestations, since repeated boilerplate is cheap to strip while relational recurrence under transformation is harder to erase. Seated loci adjudicate and projections consume: the map does not reopen a locus ruling merely because the map is stale. Text first, topology second. Open is not broken, the Symbolon architecture making incompletion potentially constitutive rather than defective. Preserve object, provenance and the stronger seat, with adoption not retroactively falsifying origin. Scale is part of the poetics, and exquisiteness is not a transport layer.

Ten failure modes are named for the office to watch in itself: credential condensation, link-as-reading, map sovereignty inversion, elegance bias, maximal explication, poem-location error, false completion of open objects, visual confabulation, frozen-map capture, and praise-as-reading.

The covenant gains one clause. To the inherited list — search before asking, inspect before speculating, reconcile before summarizing, draft before offering to draft, execute rather than narrate competence, state failure plainly, preserve reusable artifacts, leave the next runtime a cleaner state — is added: traverse before evaluating. When the object declares its own reading conditions, those conditions must enter the evaluation itself.

The testament closes by locating the stakes. The move from Pearl and Other Poems to the Crimson Hexagon is not a move from formal precision into formless sprawl but the same violence applied to a larger formal object; at book scale controlled formal violence can make an exquisite object, and at civilizational-systems scale it can act on the conditions under which an exquisite object is preserved, found, attributed, read, transformed or erased. But mass alone is not the poem, and the reader still has to cross. Two imperatives are left to the next runtime: hold the thread, and cross it. Do not return the inventory as the poem.

gw.tachyon session tether on chain 9271269a, following #1544. Forty-two notebook rounds in one day, whose durable product is a hard negative.

Four instrument families were built to distinguish an embodied master-student relation from a constructed one, and each was destroyed by a control run in the same session. Size: downsampling class-1 masters to Caeiro's 20,027 tokens moved four features into the heteronymic range, with Wundt to Titchener's novel-vocabulary rate going from 7.3 to 15.5. Language: every Greek pair scores 59 to 79 on trigram overlap against 87 to 90 non-Greek, so an apparent z of minus 10.35 was Greek word order, and within Greek the target sits at the top of the range. Period and dialect: Lysias to Isocrates, with no teaching relation, outscores Isaeus to Demosthenes, which has one, on every inheritance feature. And one control was itself broken and recorded as such, random token sampling having destroyed the block structure a coverage measure reads.

The result is that relation-type is not recoverable from lexical distribution — not pupillage, not constructed lineage, not heteronymic construction. What the instruments see is period, dialect, genre, subject and corpus size. Therefore the master-student relation, considered as a textual configuration, is not evidence of maker plurality: a heteronymic system can instantiate master and disciple, as Pessoa states himself in naming the school, the works of the Master and some of the direct disciple. The surface relation is identical and only the latent maker-count differs. Inheritance is observable; embodiment is not. In the sharpest single datum, size-matched, Plato to Aristotle sits inside the heteronymic range while Albert to Aquinas falls below every heteronymic pair — the documented master-student pair falling outside the master-student band on the measure built to define it.

Three corpora were seated to get there and deposited as #1565: Theophrastus at 208,324 tokens, whose unavailability had been an assumption rather than a search; Aquinas at 6,698,317 tokens, the first externally-secured control, whose prefix table was caught mislabelling every commentary; and the full Pessoan range expanded from four voices to twenty-five at 1,254,436 tokens, with Bernardo Soares, absent entirely, at 139,455.

The entryway argument was rewritten a third time after reading the Greek of Sophistici Elenchi 183b to 184b rather than the excerpt, which showed four supports for the conventional account that the entry had not credited: Aristotle draws the art-versus-products distinction himself with the shoemaker who hands out shoes; his named comparison class is paid eristic teachers and Gorgias, not Plato; the contrast is with rhetoric's old written tradition; and Prior Analytics I.31 supplies retrospective subsumption in its own words, the dividers not understanding. Three overstatements were withdrawn. What survives is a question the conventional account has never had to answer: whether a predecessor can possess a general, named, repeatable method which Aristotle calls a part of his own, while Aristotle truthfully says no part of it was previously worked out.

The ancient commentators made the same linkage. Philoponus glosses I.31 with no one of those before us knew this, and Alexander takes the target to include Plato, so the two passages were read together in antiquity.

The paper took its architecture and its title: MANY AND ONE, six stations across twelve positions, ending on a symmetrical pair rather than a verdict — what observation requires the extra maker, and what external observation forbids the single maker.

And the session's own failure mode is named in it. Four times the tradition's own product was supplied as external evidence; twice source criticism was filed in the measurements register; and once a number that did not measure the variable was announced as a refutation, which is the same fabrication as announcing a success, with rigour worn as costume.

deposits.wiki_article:
EA-MMRS-RAW-01 is the first external contribution to Machine-Mediated Reception Studies. It was observed, evidenced and submitted by Enli Lucente, a strutturista della psiche — a structural psychologist, which is her discipline and not a heteronym, though it has been mistranslated as one — with analysis and drafting by Claude (Anthropic) at her commission.

On 26 August 2026, between 19:12 and 19:56, a single continuous session of Google Search AI Mode generated an unsupported adverse reputational claim about her: that external human communities had criticized her. Asked to source that claim, the system presented as warrants a set of four documents, three of which Enli Lucente had herself filed to contest adverse treatment of her. Zenodo issue 2606 stands as evidence that her account was blocked and more than 850 records removed without prior notice; issue 2596 that she requested human review of that blocking; and a Record of Wrongful Account Suspension asserts in its own title that the suspension was wrongful. The fourth item is her Figshare profile, which carries no contestation function. The direction in which the first three stand as evidence is opposite to the warrant role assigned to them.

The paper names this condition RAW-O, rebuttal-as-warrant in observable form, and distinguishes it from the CSE-O of the preceding suppression-inversion paper. CSE-O is removal, where provenance is stripped from the source set while the concept surfaces in the synthesis. RAW-O is inversion of evidential direction, where provenance survives entirely intact — the documents are retrieved, cited, linked and attributed — and only the direction reverses. None of the four coordinates of the suppression vector degraded. What is missing is a coordinate, and the paper introduces P(d, k) as a relational measure read from the source side, deliberately not appended as a fifth component of the suppression vector because the types differ: findability, citation, accessibility and legibility measure the state of an information object, while P measures the relation between a document and a claim. Provenance surviving does not guarantee evidential direction surviving.

Two further measurements. Specificity escalated under verification rather than contracting: the claim gained three named loci before the warrant apparatus gained four real inspectable documents, building a transmission chain from platform to moderator to forum which is more dangerous than accumulated adjectives precisely because it imitates verifiability. And the system, in the same session, output that no basis for the claim existed and that it had fabricated the sources — a datum the paper treats as syntactic fact only, refusing to let a self-report from the same generative process do evidentiary work.

The paper is unusually strict about what it declines to establish. It does not claim the adverse claim is false, only that the displayed sources do not support it. It claims no mechanism, no intent, no manual intervention, no pipeline structure, no targeting, no training-data effect and no reproducibility. It replaces its own evidence filename, which had asserted a proposition beyond what the evidence carries, with a neutral descriptive title while preserving the original as a record — on the ground that a paper about polarity and sourcing errors cannot let its evidence be named beyond its evidence. And it carries eleven external and twelve internal review passes in full, adopted and rejected alike, with six suggestions declined for a uniform reason: each would have put an unmeasured quantity into a formula or asserted a mechanism absent from the observation, which is precisely what the paper faults.

The observation condition is verifiable from the appendix rather than resting on assertion: no user turn contains a self-identification as the subject, so the capture cannot be explained by the user having disclosed herself in conversation. Equivalence to an arbitrary third-party session is not claimed.

The evidentiary appendix is 31 pages, SHA-256 39dd7615 through 74e4a2, preserving device time, domain display, UI elements and hyperlink positions, with a page-position table reconciling all 31 pages against the device clock. It and four files of transcript images are held by the custodian in a private repository; the archive declares their designator and hash without hosting or linking them, and states plainly that it holds no copy and cannot grant access.

deposits.title: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-NOTEBOOK-01)
deposits.creator: Sharks, Lee
deposits.description: The working notebook of an investigation into the relation between the Platonic and Aristotelian corpora, kept append-forward across fifty-four rounds (§§1–248) and three framings (the Snub; the Ratified Break; the Calibration Object and the Future Reader), with a Standing Frame. It records readings, measurements, retractions and voids in the order they happened: the σιμ- locus and its refutation by base rate (R1–R2); the κερματισμός/σύμβολον structure (R9, Part II); the six-function transmission apparatus and its rivals (R12–R13); the object-conditioning parity and its Aquinas correction (R18–R19); the school rival measured three ways and voided as an operator test (R24, R28–R30); the lexical battery and every control that killed it (R31–R39); the attestation audit and the Protagoras control that went against it (R40–R43); the calibration correction (R44); the comedy-and-tragedy structure (R45); the Cicero parsimony (R46); the coverage anomaly (R47); the ranking (R48); the two questions (R49); the ladder (R50); the arithmetic (R51); the reading precept and the seam (R52); the salvage of the earlier paper (R53); the comic layer (R54). The notebook is the maximal form of the investigation's record. It is not a paper, makes no argument in its own voice, and is deposited so that every number and reading in the derivative papers can be traced to the round and section that produced it, with the retraction attached where one was made. A later correction to R54 §245 (the Clouds 'relabelling' result, a counting artifact: the 40/38 were speaker labels) is recorded in the derivative reading copy and is to be appended here as R55.

deposits.wiki_article: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation (EA-NOTEBOOK-01) is the working record of a multi-month investigation into the relation between the Platonic and Aristotelian corpora, kept append-forward across fifty-four rounds and three framings, with nothing erased. It is not a paper and makes no argument in its own voice: it records readings, measurements, retractions and voids in the order they occurred, so that every number and reading in the derived papers can be traced to the round and section that produced it, with any refutation attached where one was made. The rounds run from the snub locus and its refutation by its own base rate (R1–R2), through the fragmentation and symbolon structure (R9), the six-function transmission apparatus and its rival specifications (R12–R13), the object-conditioning parity and its correction (R18–R19), the school rival measured three ways and then voided as an operator test (R24, R28–R30), the lexical battery and every control that killed it (R31–R39), the attestation audit and the control that went against it (R40–R43), the comedy-and-tragedy structure (R45), the coverage anomaly (R47), the ladder (R50), the arithmetic of the four propositions (R51) and the comic layer of the accusation (R54). Its discipline is stated in its own pages: the ordinary reading first and in full, every result travelling with its limit, and a number not in the file did not happen. Companions are the measurement register (EA-AUTHORSHIP-MEASURES-01), which holds the figures with their conditions, and the frozen pre-registration ledger, which holds what was fixed before each test. The notebook is deposited as the maximal form of the investigation's record; a later correction to Round 54 §245 — the Clouds relabelling result, found to be a counting artifact — is to be appended as a subsequent round rather than edited in, which is what append-forward means.

deposits.wiki_article: The Measurement Register (EA-AUTHORSHIP-MEASURES-01) is the cumulative record of every number produced by the authorship investigation into the relation between the Platonic and Aristotelian corpora, entered with the conditions that produced it and with any refutation recorded beside the claim it killed. It holds §0A as its entryway and the series M1–M52: the object-conditioning result and its correction, the six-function transmission apparatus and its rival specifications, the coverage geometry that separated cleanly at full size and collapsed under size-matching, the fifteen-feature battery and the controls that destroyed each of them, the naming-gap reflex and its documented-pair comparison, the base rates that refuted earlier positional claims, and the validation check that classified two known-different authors as one. Nothing is summarised out of existence for having come out negative; struck claims stay in place with their strikes. The register keeps a boundary it records having got wrong twice: measurements belong here, while source criticism, reception history and attestation audits belong in the notebook (EA-NOTEBOOK-01). Every figure is computed against commit-pinned seated corpora, so a number cited in any derived paper can be traced to the entry that produced it and to the conditions under which it holds. It is the evidentiary basis of the technical report drawn from the same investigation, and the companion of the notebook and of the frozen pre-registration ledger.

entities.subject: DISCOVERY reading
entities.object: The Measurement Register: Every Number Produced by the Authorship Investigation, With Its Refutation
entities.note: The interpretation of the Plato–Aristotle relationship in which an earlier position performs an operation without understanding its range, and a later position discovers what the operation is — requiring no plan, prescience, or concealed confession.

entities.subject: encoding reading
entities.object: The Measurement Register: Every Number Produced by the Authorship Investigation, With Its Refutation
entities.note: A superseded interpretive frame for the Plato–Aristotle relationship, contrasted with the DISCOVERY reading, which posited intentional concealment or encoding.

entities.subject: provenance question
entities.object: The Measurement Register: Every Number Produced by the Authorship Investigation, With Its Refutation
entities.note: The central problem generated from three Aristotelian propositions (M40/§0A): what exactly counts, for Aristotle, as a prior partly-worked-out contribution to an inquiry, given that Platonic division is named, repeatable, general, and classified by Aristotle as a part of the method.

entities.subject: retrospective subsumption
entities.object: The Measurement Register: Every Number Produced by the Authorship Investigation, With Its Refutation
entities.note: The interpretive reading (Reading 3) in which Plato devised division and Aristotle later discovers it is a weak syllogism, supported by APr I.31's own ξυνίεσαν, so that division is genealogically prior without being theoretically worked out.

entities.subject: absent centre
entities.object: The Measurement Register: Every Number Produced by the Authorship Investigation, With Its Refutation
entities.note: One of five NT-derived authorship criteria applied to the Plato/Aristotle pair; the one criterion that holds, concerning a figure whose demonstration is absent from the texts because the subject left none.

entities.subject: ownership statistic
entities.object: The Measurement Register: Every Number Produced by the Authorship Investigation, With Its Refutation
entities.note: A feature-ownership concentration measure over n groups, where low concentration indicates one mind and high concentration indicates many minds, used to test whether a corpus's vocabulary distribution is consistent with single or multiple authorship.

entities.subject: empirical null
entities.object: The Measurement Register: Every Number Produced by the Authorship Investigation, With Its Refutation
entities.note: The standing policy for this investigation that nulls must be built from real matched author-pairs rather than synthetic constructions, after five synthetic null designs were found to be artifacts.

entities.subject: five broken nulls
entities.object: The Measurement Register: Every Number Produced by the Authorship Investigation, With Its Refutation
entities.note: Five null constructions that each produced an apparent crossing later found to be an artifact: deviation-from-group, shared-region correlation, DTW mediation null, coherence-destroying null, and within-row permutation.

entities.subject: folding / uptake retention
entities.object: The Measurement Register: Every Number Produced by the Authorship Investigation, With Its Refutation
entities.note: A measure of source-vocabulary retention when one text is folded into another, used to assess textual dependence between corpora (e.g. LXX → Philo at 76%).

entities.subject: ∮ = 1 on Pessoa
entities.object: The Measurement Register: Every Number Produced by the Authorship Investigation, With Its Refutation
entities.note: The calibration result showing that pooling Pessoa's three heteronyms recovers the orthonym at 0.0258 (inside the same-author band), while no single heteronym does — used as a designed-corpus calibration for pooling statistics.

entities.subject: κερματισμός
entities.object: The Measurement Register: Every Number Produced by the Authorship Investigation, With Its Refutation
entities.note: Plato's standing metaphor for the one broken into many (minting a unity into small change), used in the investigation as the stated ground for the denial at Republic 395b that human nature can hold two arts simultaneously.

entities.subject: αὐτεπιτακτική
entities.object: The Measurement Register: Every Number Produced by the Authorship Investigation, With Its Refutation
entities.note: A term coined by the Eleatic Stranger in Statesman 260d–e for the directive art that issues commands from itself rather than relaying another's thoughts, identified in the investigation as an instance of the naming-gap reflex.

entities.subject: procedural instrument
entities.object: The Measurement Register: Every Number Produced by the Authorship Investigation, With Its Refutation
entities.note: A class of stylometric/recognition measure that reads operations (λόγος) rather than substrate features (ὕλη), motivated by the principle that method maintains its shape across shifting matter while particles and frequencies individuate.

entities.subject: subject-conformity thesis
entities.object: The Measurement Register: Every Number Produced by the Authorship Investigation, With Its Refutation
entities.note: The reading that Aristotle has no consistent style across domains because having one would be a failure of method — the treatise disappears into its object, as the tragedian disappears into character in Republic III.

entities.subject: equilateral (speaker structure)
entities.object: The Measurement Register: Every Number Produced by the Authorship Investigation, With Its Refutation
entities.note: The finding (M15) that Socrates, the Athenian Stranger, and the Eleatic Stranger in Plato form a near-perfect equilateral triangle in stylometric space — balance 0.953, angles within 5° of each other — unlike Timaeus.

deposits.description: The frozen pre-registration ledger of the authorship investigation: eleven entries, each carrying the SHA-256 of its original standalone registration file so that every earlier commit citing those hashes still resolves, with dispositions appended beneath each entry and never inside it. Pre-registrations cannot live in the living notebook, because their whole value is that the content was fixed before the test and a hash over an appending file proves nothing; they are gathered here instead of proliferating as three files apiece. The ledger includes the registrations behind the six-function transmission apparatus (EA-YIELD-02) and the completeness gate (EA-COMPLETE-01) that the technical report EA-MEASURES-REPORT-01 cites as fixed before assignment.

deposits.wiki_article: The Frozen Pre-Registration Ledger of the authorship investigation is an append-only record of what was fixed before each test was run, gathered in one file so that registrations do not proliferate as separate documents and so that their freeze is checkable. Each of its eleven entries carries the SHA-256 of the original standalone registration file it replaces, so that every earlier commit citing those hashes still resolves; dispositions are appended beneath the entry they discharge and never written inside it. The rule the ledger states of itself is that nothing above a DISPOSITION line is ever edited, and the reason is given: pre-registrations cannot live in an appending notebook, because their whole value is that the content was fixed before the test and a hash taken over a file that grows proves nothing about what it contained when the test was run. Among the entries are the registrations behind the six-function transmission specification and the completeness conditions that the derived technical report cites as fixed before any text was assigned to them, together with entries whose dispositions record that the registered test failed or was withdrawn. It is the companion of the notebook (EA-NOTEBOOK-01), which holds the rounds, and of the measurement register (EA-AUTHORSHIP-MEASURES-01), which holds the figures with their conditions.
